description: routing_mailer.rs:65 glob_matches('*.example.com', 'example.com') returns true. DNS glob semantics (RFC 1034) say * matches exactly one label so bare domain should not match. Test comment says 'bare domain also matches' — intentional but undocumented in operator guide. Can silently misroute apex-domain mail through wrong provider.
title: glob *.example.com matches bare example.com (non-standard)
